title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Job Information Date Opened 11/19/2026 Job Type Full time City Chennai State/Province Tamil Nadu Country India Zip/Postal Code 600096 Industry Technology Job Description Site Reliability Engineer – Job Description Role purpose Improve availability, reliability and operational resilience of AWS/Azure-hosted platform services; own infrastructure-level troubleshooting and execution beyond L1 monitoring. Key responsibilities Provide L2 engineering for EC2, EBS, FSx, S3, ECS, Auto Scaling, RDS and agreed Azure compute/storage/infrastructure. Investigate degradation using Datadog, CloudWatch, AWS Health Dashboard and Azure telemetry; correlate application, container, host and cloud signals. Resolve/coordinate disk and storage capacity issues on Odoo EC2 servers and EBS volumes; validate filesystem growth, volume use and service impact. Troubleshoot ECS task-state changes, restart alerts, unhealthy services and deployment issues for MSSQL clusters and Commerce-api. Execute approved ECS service updates/forced deployments and EC2 Auto Scaling Group instance refreshes; validate instance health, capacity and application recovery. Review AWS account health events and determine infrastructure impact, mitigation and escalation requirements. Support network diagnosis, including replication path and port 1433 reachability over designated VPN; coordinate firewall/routing/VPN changes with authorized owners. Own infrastructure monitoring quality; review Datadog dashboards weekly, identify telemetry gaps and tune thresholds with approval. Contribute to AWS/Azure capacity management through storage growth, compute utilization, scaling and resource allocation analysis. Validate EC2 OS patch compliance for Windows, Linux and WordPress hosts; coordinate windows, pre/post checks and exception reporting. Review CSPM findings, validate cloud configuration context and coordinate remediation with designated security/cloud stakeholders. Support S3 archive validation and restore prerequisites; DBA retains database-level recovery ownership. Plan and participate in quarterly DR exercises for SQL Server FSx and RDS PaaS; validate infrastructure dependencies and recovery. Automate repetitive health checks, alert enrichment, evidence capture and routine remediation using PowerShell/Python/cloud-native automation, subject to review and approval. Maintain infrastructure runbooks, scripts, monitoring standards and known-error documentation; lead infrastructure RCA. Required skills and experience Hands-on AWS operations: EC2, EBS, FSx, S3, ECS, Auto Scaling, RDS and AWS Health. Working Azure infrastructure services and monitoring. ECS/container operations and deployment troubleshooting. Linux/Windows administration, storage, patching and service troubleshooting. Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor and observability. TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewall, VPN and service-port validation. Reliability, incident response, capacity, resilience, DR and PowerShell/Python automation. KPIs / expected outcomes Cloud/platform incidents handled within agreed SLAs. Monitoring signal quality improved and avoidable alert noise reduced. Approved instance refreshes, ECS deployments and patch activities evidenced. Capacity and cloud health risks proactively identified. Automation with measurable effort/response-time reduction. DR findings and reliability actions closed. Authority and boundaries SRE owns infrastructure/platform engineering, not application code fixes or database-level tuning; database incidents are worked jointly with DBA. Production changes, failovers, security remediation and network-policy changes require approval. AI NOC is not assumed to replace SRE; automation requires human approval/rollback controls.

description: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I Do you enjoy building reliable cloud platforms using Azure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation? Would you like to help create secure, scalable systems while collaborating with software engineering and security teams? About the Business LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/ About our Team Our DevOps/SRE team supports a regulated identity and risk platform running on Microsoft Azure across multiple regions, including FedRAMP and UK environments. We own the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, observability and security posture for a portfolio of Java-based services and data pipelines. We are currently modernizing our platform by moving workloads from Kubernetes (AKS) to Azure Container Apps, so it's a great time to join and help shape how our services are built and run. About the Role The Senior DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security and operational maturity of our Azure-hosted platform. The role combines infrastructure-as-code, platform engineering, release engineering and operational support. You will work closely with development, QA, security, release management and central platform teams to deliver automation, observability, compliance and platform modernization initiatives. Responsibilities Support highly available production services across multiple environments and participate in on-call and major incident response and operational side of databases, caches, file storage, scheduled jobs and ETL pipelines, and the test automation infrastructure used in our pipelines. Investigate incidents and service degradation, lead recovery, and produce Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) with corrective actions and lead the migration of workloads from AKS to Azure Container Apps (ACA), including environment design, networking, secrets, scaling and observability. Design, build and operate Azure infrastructure using Terraform, and maintain Kubernetes (AKS) clusters and Helm-based deployments to build and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including image promotion, GitOps (ArgoCD) and blue/green releases. Drive container and supply chain security: hardened/FIPS-compliant images, vulnerability scanning and remediation, and FedRAMP compliance controls, in partnership with InfoSec and improve observability through monitoring, logging, tracing, synthetic checks, dashboards, alerting and SLOs. Manage secrets, identities and TLS certificates, including automated rotation and renewal, cloud networking, including VNet peering, private endpoints, DNS and firewall rules as code. Track and report on vulnerabilities and compliance, and keep container registries, artifacts and Terraform state well maintained. Participate in release coordination, change management, disaster recovery, blue/green failover and capacity planning and identify recurring issues and automate operational toil to improve reliability and developer productivity. Partner with development, QA, database, security and operations teams to promote operational excellence and continuous improvement. Requirements Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including AKS, Azure Container Apps, ACR, Key Vault, VNets/private networking, Entra ID and managed identities. Strong knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, Helm, cloud networking, IAM/RBAC and distributed systems. Proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across multiple environments. Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD tooling, including GitOps and progressive delivery (ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts). Experience securing container workloads, including image hardening, vulnerability remediation (e.g., Wiz, Defender, Xray), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, Akeyless) and compliance controls; FedRAMP experience is a plus. Experience with observability tools such as Elastic, Grafana, Prometheus and Open Telemetry. Strong incident management skills, including technical recovery, RCA facilitation and corrective actions. Experience with Linux administration and scripting in Bash, Python or PowerShell. Our Tech Stack Cloud: Microsoft Azure: Container Apps (ACA), AKS, ACR, Key Vault, Azure Firewall, VNets/Private Endpoints, Azure Files, Azure Managed Redis, Azure OpenAI, Azure Monitor Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, tflint, Trivy Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts, KEDA CI/CD & Release: GitHub Actions, JFrog Artifactory, ServiceNow DevOps, Jira Observability: Elastic (APM, logs, synthetics), OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana Security & Compliance: Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Containers, Prisma Cloud, JFrog Xray, Mend, Checkmarx, OpenSCAP, FedRAMP Secrets & Identity: HashiCorp Vault, Akeyless, Entra ID, Managed/Workload Identity Applications & Data: Java/Spring Boot, Tomcat, Apache Hop (ETL), MySQL, Redis Scripting: Bash, Python, PowerShell Our Commitment to Inclusion We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non-traditional education or experience.
